items.title: Metals.io issues tokens backed by 25 tonnes of physical copper stored in Germany
items.summary: The company is starting with $366,000 worth of copper stored in Germany, hoping to build a market for investors to own and trade physical metal onchain.

items.title: China’s Communist Party calls for a crackdown on corruption that uses crypto and blockchain
items.summary: China's Communist Party has named virtual currency and blockchain in a new anti-corruption call.

items.summary: The $6.3 billion Binance breach has revived a debate over whether crypto exchanges are less secure than banks or simply harder to protect once hackers get inside.

items.summary: The first trading day after the Binance hack saw  the biggest ETF outflow since June 25.

items.title: Bitcoin claws back toward $79,000 as markets shake off crypto's biggest hack
items.summary: ZEC led the majors and oil slid on a report that Trump wants to give Iran diplomacy more time, with U.S. midterm elections on Tuesday.

items.title: BTCPay, a bitcoin payment tool, tells users to switch off their servers after reports of drained wallets
items.summary: The open-source project says it is still investigating and hasn't given a loss figure or announced a fix. Its founder said the reports appear to involve versions older than 2.4.2.

items.title: The crypto reader's guide to the 2026 midterm election: State of Crypto

items.title: BTC heads into US midterm showdown: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week

items.title: OKX draws $445M in net inflows as Binance outflows exceed $7B

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs sink into October outflows with $643M exit after Binance hack
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs ended October with $515 million in net withdrawals, while Ether funds posted a record $1.61 billion in monthly outflows.

items.title: BTCPay Server warns of hot wallet thefts running on outdated software
items.summary: BTCPay Server urged operators to shut down their servers after receiving reports of unauthorized attackers draining funds from hot wallets.

items.title: Bank of Korea probes financial firms’ exposure to crypto risks
items.summary: The central bank is surveying 31 financial institutions on how a major exchange shutdown, prolonged crypto downturn or losses at another firm could affect their operations.

items.title: THORChain halts swaps after block reorg bug, slowing Binance hackers
items.summary: THORChain node operators paused swaps involving assets on 10 networks, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and Tron.

items.summary: The exchange says withdrawals surged after some services resumed but have since slowed, with the outflows representing a fraction of its roughly $171 billion in customer assets.

items.summary: The proposal comes amid intense competition among AI developers, including US companies Anthropic and OpenAI, the SCMP said.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF Investors Head for the Exits After Record Binance Hack

items.title: Binance Hack Shows Why Offshore Exchanges Need US Oversight, CFTC Chair Says
items.summary: Michael Selig said the record $6.4 billion theft shows why offshore exchanges should register with the CFTC and adopt U.S.-grade cybersecurity standards.

items.title: Intel Stock Suffers Worst Crash in 50 Years as Weak Forecast Overshadows AI Chip Demand
items.summary: Intel beat third-quarter earnings expectations, but warned of a prolonged PC slump, sending shares to their worst daily decline in 50 years.

items.title: Worried About Crypto Hacks? Buy Bitcoin Proxies in Stock Market Instead, Say Wall Street Firms
items.summary: Analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald, TD Cowen and Compass Point say the record $6.4 billion theft is a Binance security failure, not a crypto-wide threat, pointing clients toward proxies like Coinbase, Robinhood, and Strategy.

items.title: Reddit Stock Plunges 30% as Google's AI Search Hits Traffic and User Growth
items.summary: Reddit shares are down 44% this week after CEO Steve Huffman warned that Google's AI-powered search features are cutting referrals, while weaker user growth and disappointing fourth-quarter guidance added to investor con

items.title: Binance Hack: Why Bitcoin Didn't Crash Like It Did in 2018
items.summary: Binance lost about $6.4 billion, the largest crypto hack on record, yet Bitcoin fell about 3%, against nearly 11% in 2018 when the exchange was last attacked.

items.title: $8 Million Crypto Kidnapping Lands Texas Brothers 15-Year Prison Terms
items.summary: Raymond and Isiah Garcia held a Minnesota family at gunpoint for more than nine hours, forcing the father to transfer over $8 million in crypto, in one of the clearest “wrench attack” prosecutions yet.
